admission.justification: A future classifier must not promote locator repair alone into meaning change or hide it merely because it fixes evidence already stale at base.

applicability: The four-tree reviewer reanchor boundary chosen in MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6.
conditions: A nonmechanical repair of an entry anchor, including an entry stale at base, is classified as implementation evidence independently of recorded invariant text; intent still comes from the recorded-meaning owner.
exclusions: A purely mechanical carry can be ignored by carried_mechanically; an unreadable base class remains unknown; a concurrent actual invariant-text change is not declared unchanged.
statement: Re-anchoring a stale entry changes implementation evidence rather than the invariant's meaning.
